text: あとは　これを　もっていけ

structure.jp: これを　もっていけ

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says you do it and then go away. Here it ends in け, a blunt order. もっていけ = 'take it with you'.

patterns.name: 〜え (command)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of a verb to the え row makes a blunt order. もっていけ = 'take it along!'.
